title: FREYALISE
description: Learn more about Freyalise, the half-elf Planeswalker from Magic: The Gathering.

paragraphs.text: A half-elven Planeswalker from a bygone era, Freyalise was a leader of elven clans who used her incredible power to protect their forest home. She heroically sacrificed her life to save her people and prevented a catastrophe that threatened to destroy Dominaria.
